name: Big 'n Blind Guangzhou 2019

venue.name: Guangzhou Nanwu Middle School
venue.address: No. 81 Xingyuan Street, Jiangnanxi Road, Haizhu District

information: It's the 4th yearly Big 'n Blind Open in Guangzhou, which is only for big cubes and blindfold events. The main event is 4x4x4. Please check the [competition website](https://cubingchina.com/competition/BignBlind-Guangzhou-2019) for more information (events, schedule, etc).
